rights_and_task_review.content_origin: Authors describe everyday home fabrics captured with smartphones.
rights_and_task_review.student_task: Locate visible marks on clothing to support pre-wash care and compare how marks are noticed across fabrics.
task_limits: Does not establish whether an item is clean, wearable, safe, or successfully cleaned.
rights_and_task_review.patterned_textiles: Included in the source dataset and not treated as a disqualifying factor.

sample_visual_review.result: Textile images and spot annotations were consistent in sampled images; sample review is not a manual review of every image.

annotations.transformation: Map category id 1 to common class id 0; convert COCO xywh to normalized center xywh; clip edge-overrun boxes to image bounds.
